name: Shipment Delivery Report
purpose: Tracks on-time delivery and freight cost per kilogram for each carrier and lane

inputs.sales_order_ref: Number of the sales order the shipment was sent for
inputs.origin_hub: Hub or depot the shipment left from
inputs.destination_city: City the shipment was sent to
inputs.carrier: Courier company that carried the shipment
inputs.ship_date: Date the shipment left the hub
inputs.estimated_arrival: Date the shipment was expected to arrive
inputs.delivered_at: Date and time the shipment was actually delivered
inputs.gross_weight: Total weight of the shipment, including packaging
inputs.parcel_dimensions: Length, width and height of the parcel
inputs.lane_distance: Distance by road from the origin hub to the destination
inputs.freight_cost: Amount the carrier charged to move the shipment
inputs.status: Where the shipment is now, e.g. in transit or delivered
inputs.goods_value: Value of the goods inside the shipment, as declared for insurance
inputs.item_count: Number of items packed in the shipment
